top_choice_rationale: Melitz's framework made firm productivity heterogeneity, selection, and aggregate trade gains jointly analyzable. It is mature and deeply influential, and its foundational contribution has unusually clean sole-person attribution when the citation is confined to that originating framework.
recusal_note: None apparent from the supplied profile. My disclosed long-term coauthors include John Hassler and Timo Boppart, who are committee members, but no profile-based connection to Marc J. Melitz is stated.
